format: Captured web tool result strings, not raw HTTP response bodies
observation_scope: Official primary pages/PDFs were directly opened and inspected in this design turn. Search results remain discovery-only; no failed HTTP fetch is represented as a successful raw capture.
limits: Tool extraction may omit presentation details; direct raw PDF captures independently preserved where successful.
The extracted response includes irrelevant search results; these are not used as primary support.
No original MIM supplier, SKU or batch is inferred from these documents.
